title: 第93章 朽气侵体首领受挫第92章 首领拦路高阶对决
slug: 朽道归墟我以残灵证长生
lines: 轰隆——！
天地碰撞的终极轰鸣炸裂四野，震彻整座青玄宗千万峰峦。
纯白浩瀚的天道镇世轮与灰暗深邃的朽道长矛凌空对撞，黑白两股截然对立、水火不容的本源力量疯狂撕扯、湮灭、暴动。恐怖的能量冲击波以二人为核心疯狂扩散，高空云层尽数碾成齑粉，百里长空灵气彻底暴乱，下方擂台残存的结界屏障瞬间布满蛛网裂痕，无数坚硬的千年灵玉台面层层崩碎、轰然塌陷。
漫天肆虐的灵力飓风席卷全场，吹得数万围观弟子衣袂狂舞、身形不稳，无数人被迫运转灵力护体，心神被这等颠覆认知的高阶碰撞彻底震慑，浑身冰冷、战栗不止。
这是真正触及宗门顶层战力的绝杀对决，是万古正统伪道与新生朽道逆途的本源碰撞，每一寸能量震荡都带着颠覆修行认知的恐怖威势。
长空中央，两股极致力量的僵持仅仅维持了短短一瞬。
玄风长老倾尽金丹中期本源、燃烧精血寿元催动的禁术天道镇世轮，看似威压滔天、镇封万物，承载着天地正统的镇压之力，却在接触朽道长矛的刹那，瞬间显露颓势。
灰色朽道纹路如同附骨之疽，顺着纯白道轮的天道纹理极速攀爬、蔓延、侵蚀。
正统灵力最惧朽道拆解，天道规则最畏逆道腐朽。原本无坚不摧、可镇杀万邪的天道镇世轮，表层光洁神圣的纯白灵光以肉眼可见的速度黯淡、斑驳、消退，密密麻麻的灰黑腐朽纹路飞速覆盖整座道轮，原本规整神圣的天道符文不断崩裂、寂灭、紊乱。
“不！不可能！”
玄风长老瞳孔骤缩，苍老的面容瞬间布满极致的惊骇与难以置信，失声低吼，语气里满是颠覆认知的惶恐。
天道镇世轮乃是青玄宗千年禁术，借天地正统之力加持，可镇压异端、净化邪秽、封禁万法，是正统大道的终极体现。以往出手，无往不利、万邪辟易，从未有任何异法能够正面抗衡、侵蚀拆解。
可今日，这等无上禁术，竟被一名刚刚突破半步金丹的少年，以一己朽道之力正面压制、层层腐朽！
惊骇之余，剧烈的反噬剧痛骤然席卷全身。
天道镇世轮与玄风的金丹道基深度绑定、本源相连，术法受损，本体必遭反噬。随着道轮表层纹路大面积崩碎、腐朽，一股冰冷刺骨的诡异力量顺着灵力羁绊反向冲刷，瞬间冲破他的护体灵光，侵入四肢百骸、经脉丹田，死死扎根在他修行近百年的圆满金丹道基之上。
滋滋——
细微却刺耳的腐朽声响在他体内悄然传开，外人无法听闻，唯有玄风自身清晰感知。
那股灰色朽气不带半分狂暴杀伐，却比世间任何剧毒、任何秘术都更为恐怖。它不冲击肉身、不撕裂经脉，而是精准针对修士最核心、最根本的道基本源，顺着正统道纹的脉络极速渗透、扎根、啃噬。
玄风瞬间浑身僵硬，周身磅礴流转的金丹灵力骤然一滞，随即出现大面积的紊乱、断层、溃散。
此前他强行压制、隐匿道基深处的天道朽毒，本就根深蒂固、常年蛰伏，只是被圆满的正统灵力强行掩盖，从未爆发。此刻外来朽气侵入本源，如同星火燎原，瞬间引燃了他道基深处沉淀近百年的腐朽隐患。
内外朽气交织共振，疯狂侵蚀、瓦解、腐化他的金丹本源。
一瞬间，玄风只感觉自己苦修百年的圆满道基，仿佛化作了风化千年的朽木，原本稳固坚实、灵光充沛的道基内核，开始发软、发腐、空洞，源源不断的本源力量被强行拆解、消磨、流失。
剧烈的酸胀、麻木、腐朽、撕裂的多重剧痛席卷神魂，让他这位历经无数杀伐、心性坚韧的金丹长老，身躯都忍不住微微颤抖。
“道基……在腐朽！”
玄风牙关紧咬，齿间渗出细密血丝，心底掀起滔天恐惧。
他活了近百年，修行近百载，一生顺天而行、恪守正统，始终坚信天道无瑕、大道圆满，从未想过自己倾尽一生打磨的金丹道基，竟会有腐朽崩坏的一日，更从未想过，世间竟有力量能直接侵蚀修士本源道基、瓦解修行根基。
这种侵蚀无声无息、无从抵御、无法净化，不同于肉身伤势、灵力损耗，道基受损乃是修行根本的重创，难以修复、不可逆转。
“给我稳住！凝道基、镇邪秽！”
玄风强忍神魂剧痛，心神极致紧绷，疯狂催动体内残存的正统灵力，试图镇压侵入本源的朽气，冲刷道基腐纹、稳固金丹内核。
可一切皆是徒劳挣扎。
朽气克尽万法、逆道凌驾天道。越是催动正统灵力镇压，正统道纹与朽气的碰撞便越是剧烈，道基的腐朽速度便越是迅猛。他引以为傲的圆满正统灵力，此刻非但无法抵御邪秽，反而成了滋养朽气、加速本源崩坏的养料。
原本澄澈纯粹、灵光饱满的金丹内核，肉眼可见地蒙上了一层暗沉灰雾，表层细密的道纹不断崩碎、脱落、湮灭，稳固的道基壁垒愈发疏松、脆弱。
半空之中，巨大的天道镇世轮彻底失去本源支撑，光芒飞速黯淡，轮转速度越来越迟缓，繁复神圣的天道符文大面积熄灭、崩解，再也没有半分镇压天地的恐怖威势。
咔嚓、咔嚓——
密集的碎裂声连绵响起，贯穿长空。
承载青玄宗禁术之力的天道镇世轮，在漫天朽气的侵蚀拆解下，彻底崩碎瓦解，化作漫天细碎的纯白灵气残渣，混杂着灰色朽纹，随风消散虚空。
倾尽精血寿元的终极禁术，彻底告破！
长空之上，风压骤减、灵力溃散。
林寂立身虚空，身形挺拔如松，周身灰色朽气凝练内敛、平稳流转，没有丝毫紊乱动荡。突破半步金丹之后的本源力量彻底稳固，气息愈发厚重深邃，逆道威压静静铺开，笼罩整片高空。
刚才的终极碰撞，他看似与禁术势均力敌、剧烈对冲，实则全程稳稳掌控战局、借力淬炼自身。
玄风燃烧本源、透支寿元打出的禁术攻势，看似凶险绝伦，实则蕴含着海量高阶天道道痕。这些源自金丹禁术、触及天地规则的顶级道痕，尽数被林寂的吸纳漩涡吞噬熔炼，彻底夯实了他半步金丹的修为根基，让他的战力、肉身、神魂、术法掌控力，完成全方位的迭代升华。
他不仅毫发无伤，反而越战越强、越战越稳。
content_en:
Boom——!
The ultimate roar of the collision between heaven and earth exploded in all directions and shook the entire Qingxuan Sect.
The pure white and vast Heavenly Dao World-Suppressing Wheel collided with the dark and deep gray rotten Dao spear in the air. The two diametrically opposed and incompatible original forces of black and white were tearing apart, annihilating, and rioting crazily. The terrifying energy shock wave spread wildly with the two as the core. All the high-altitude clouds were crushed into powder. The spiritual energy in the sky was completely rioted. The remaining barrier of the arena below was instantly covered with spider web cracks. Countless layers of hard thousand-year-old spiritual jade platforms shattered and collapsed.
The raging spiritual hurricane swept across the entire venue, causing tens of thousands of onlookers to dance wildly and become unstable. Countless people were forced to use spiritual protection. Their minds were completely shaken by this high-level collision that subverted their cognition, and their whole bodies were cold and trembling.
This is a decisive showdown that truly touches the top level of the sect's combat power. It is the original collision between the eternal orthodox false path and the new rotten path. Every inch of energy shock carries the terrifying power that subverts the cognition of cultivation.
In the center of the sky, the stalemate between the two extreme forces only lasted for a short moment.
Elder Xuanfeng poured out the essence of the middle stage of the golden elixir and used the burning essence and blood to activate the forbidden art of Heavenly Dao World Suppressing Wheel. It seemed to be overwhelming and suppressed all things, carrying the suppressive power of the orthodoxy of heaven and earth. However, the moment it came into contact with the spear of the rotten path, it instantly showed its decline.
The gray lines of decay are like gangrene attached to bones, climbing, spreading, and eroding rapidly along the texture of the pure white wheel of heaven.
The orthodox spiritual power is most afraid of the dismantling of the corrupt way, and the rules of the heavenly way are most afraid of the corruption of the contrary way. The Heavenly Dao World-Suppressing Wheel, which was originally indestructible and capable of killing all evils, saw the clean and sacred pure white spiritual light on the surface dim, mottle, and fade away at a speed visible to the naked eye. Dense gray-black decaying lines quickly covered the entire Daowheel. The originally neat and sacred Heavenly Dao runes continued to crack, disappear, and become disordered.
"No! Impossible!"
Elder Xuanfeng's pupils shrank suddenly, his old face was instantly filled with extreme horror and disbelief, and he roared, his tone full of panic that subverted his cognition.
The Tiandao Zhenshi Lun is a thousand-year forbidden technique of Qingxuan Sect. It is blessed by the orthodox power of heaven and earth. It can suppress heretics, purify evil and filth, and ban all laws. It is the ultimate embodiment of the orthodox path. In the past, attacks have been invincible and all evils have been eliminated. There has never been any strange method that can directly confront, corrode and dismantle it.
But today, this supreme forbidden technique was suppressed head-on by a young man who had just broken through the half-step golden elixir, and was corrupted layer by layer with his own power of decay!
In addition to the horror, severe backlash pain suddenly swept through his body.
The Tiandao World-Suppressing Wheel is deeply bound and connected to the origin of Xuanfeng's Jindan Taoist foundation. If the technique is damaged, the body will suffer backlash. As the surface lines of the Taoist wheel collapsed and decayed in large areas, a cold and strange force washed away along the spiritual bonds, instantly breaking through his body-protecting aura, invading his limbs, bones, meridians and dantian, and taking root firmly on the perfect golden elixir foundation that he had practiced for nearly a hundred years.
Sizzling——
The subtle but harsh sound of decay spread quietly within his body. Outsiders could not hear it, but Xuanfeng himself could clearly sense it.
That gray rotten energy didn't contain any violent killing, but it was more terrifying than any poison or any secret technique in the world. It does not impact the physical body or tear the meridians, but precisely targets the core and most fundamental Tao source of the monks, quickly penetrating, taking root, and gnawing away along the veins of the orthodox Tao patterns.
Xuanfeng's whole body stiffened instantly, and the majestic golden elixir spiritual power flowing around him suddenly stagnated, and then large areas of chaos, faults, and collapse appeared.
He had previously suppressed and concealed the rotten poison of Heavenly Dao deep in the Dao Foundation. It was already deep-rooted and dormant all year round, but it was forcibly covered up by the perfect orthodox spiritual power and never broke out. At this moment, the foreign rotten energy invaded the source, like a spark igniting a prairie fire, instantly igniting the hidden danger of decay that had accumulated deep in his foundation for nearly a hundred years.
The internal and external decayed energy intertwined and resonated, crazily eroding, disintegrating, and corrupting the origin of his golden elixir.
For a moment, Xuanfeng felt that the perfect Taoist foundation that he had worked hard for hundreds of years had turned into rotten wood that had been weathered for thousands of years. The core of the Taoist foundation that was originally solid, solid, and full of aura began to become soft, rotten, and hollow, and the endless source of power was forcibly dismantled, worn away, and lost.
Severe soreness, numbness, decay, and tearing pains swept through his soul, making his body, a golden elixir elder who had experienced countless killings and a tough mind, couldn't help but tremble slightly.
"Doji...is decaying!"
Xuanfeng clenched his teeth tightly, fine blood oozing out between his teeth, and he felt terrible fear in his heart.
He has lived and practiced for nearly a hundred years. He has followed nature and adhered to orthodoxy all his life. He has always believed that the way of heaven is flawless and the way is perfect. He never thought that the golden elixir foundation that he spent his whole life polishing would one day decay and collapse. He never thought that there would be power in the world that could directly erode the original foundation of a monk and disintegrate the foundation of practice.
This kind of erosion is silent, impossible to resist, and cannot be purified. Unlike physical injuries and loss of spiritual power, damage to the Tao foundation is a serious damage to the foundation of practice, which is difficult to repair and irreversible.
"Hold still! Condensate Daoji and suppress evil and evil!"
Xuanfeng endured the severe pain in his soul, his mind was extremely tense, and he frantically activated the remaining orthodox spiritual power in his body, trying to suppress the decayed energy that invaded the source, wash away the rotten lines of the Taoist foundation, and stabilize the core of the golden elixir.
But everything is in vain.
The decayed energy overcomes all dharmas and goes against the will of heaven. The more orthodox spiritual power is used to suppress it, the more intense the collision between orthodox Dao patterns and decayed energy becomes, and the faster the Dao base decays. The perfect and orthodox spiritual power that he was proud of was not only unable to resist evil and filth, but instead became the nourishment that nourished the decayed energy and accelerated the collapse of the original source.
The core of the golden elixir, which was originally clear, pure, and full of aura, was visibly covered with a layer of dark gray mist. The fine Dao patterns on the surface continued to collapse, fall off, and were annihilated, and the stable Dao base barrier became increasingly loose and fragile.
In mid-air, the huge Tiandao World-Suppressing Wheel completely lost its original support, the light dimmed rapidly, the rotation speed became slower and slower, the complex and sacred Tiandao runes were extinguished and disintegrated in large areas, and it no longer had any terrifying power to suppress the world.
Click, click——
Intense cracking sounds continued throughout the sky.
The Tiandao World-Suppressing Wheel, which carried the power of the Qingxuan Sect's forbidden technique, was completely disintegrated by the erosion and dismantling of the decaying air in the sky, turning into fine pure white spiritual energy residues all over the sky, mixed with gray decaying lines, and dissipated into the void with the wind.
The ultimate forbidden technique that drained all the energy, blood and longevity was completely broken!
Above the sky, the wind pressure suddenly decreased and the spiritual power collapsed.
Lin Ji stands in the void, with a figure as tall and straight as a pine. The gray decayed energy around his body is condensed and restrained, flowing smoothly without any disorder or turmoil. After breaking through the half-step golden elixir, the original power is completely stable, the aura becomes thicker and deeper, and the pressure of the reverse path quietly spreads out, covering the entire sky.
In the final collision just now, he seemed to be evenly matched with the forbidden technique and violently clashed, but in fact, he steadily controlled the battle situation throughout the whole process and used the force to temper himself.
Xuanfeng burns his origin and overdraws his longevity. The offensive of forbidden arts seems extremely dangerous, but in fact it contains a large number of high-level traces of the way of heaven. These top Dao marks originating from the golden elixir forbidden technique and touching the rules of heaven and earth were all swallowed up and smelted by Lin Ji's absorption vortex, which completely solidified the foundation of his half-step golden elixir cultivation, allowing his combat power, body, soul, and spell control to complete all-round iterative sublimation.
Not only was he unscathed, but he became stronger and more stable as he fought.
title_en: Chapter 93: The leader of the rotten energy invades the body is frustrated Chapter 92: The leader blocks the road in a high-level duel
